recipes.name: Curry Powder
instructions: Add all the ingredients (except the turmeric and ginger) to a medium pan over medium heat. Cook until the spices become aromatic, about 2 to 3 minutes. Set aside to cool.
When cool, grind the spices into a fine powder using a grinder.
Mix in the turmeric and ginger, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Store in an airtight container or jar, in a cool, dark cupboard, for up to 6 months.
